verdict.rationale: LangGraph's core model is an explicit graph of State, Nodes and Edges in which deterministic steps and LLM-driven agent steps mix, other patterns can be embedded as nodes, and "complex, looping workflows" are a documented goal. Independent community commentary confirms its Pregel/BSP orchestration handles cycles and built-in parallelism without data races. Missing for 10: first-party evidence of conditional branching/routing edges, first-party documentation of parallel fan-out (parallelism is attested only by community sources).
